votes.description: Cryptographically secure and strictly anonymous cast ballots. Decoupled from voter identities to enforce secret ballot guarantees.

choices.description: Map of position ID to selected candidate ID or abstain token

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when ballot was deposited

isPractice.description: Whether ballot was cast in demo/practice booth mode

voter_tokens.description: Cryptographic voter authorization tokens and eligibility registry. Used to enforce one-vote-per-student limit without exposing ballot choices.

token.description: Unique 8-character voter PIN or access token

hasVoted.description: True once the student has cast a ballot

votedAt.description: Timestamp when ballot was cast (null if not voted)

status.description: Status of the token: active, used, or revoked

issuedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the token was issued

agent_monitoring.description: Live real-time observer and candidate polling agent telemetry, check-ins, and heartbeat records.

agentName.description: Name of the polling agent or observer

representedCandidate.description: Aspirant or party being observed, or Independent

role.description: Candidate Agent, Independent Observer, or EC Monitor

lastHeartbeat.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent agent ping

station.description: Assigned polling station or online booth

notes.description: Observations or scrutiny remarks logged by agent

election_metadata.description: Real-time election configuration, status, and synchronization state.

status.description: Setup, Open, Paused, Closed, or Results Published

updatedBy.description: User or administrator who performed the update
